text: Commander, there's an order to things. We have to meet someone first — we can't move on without them.
Not yet. There's something we need to get first.
We're not ready. There's a blueprint we need to find first.
There's a prerequisite mission left. We have to finish something first.
[haughty] My — what poor manners for a guest. The toll for this sector belongs to my company. Pay... or be liquidated.
[cold] War is just another transaction, Commander. I'll log your fleet as a liability in my ledger.
[bitter] This... is a loss my ledger didn't account for. Next quarter, I will collect it — without fail.
